items.title: Equinix gains as record bookings bolster AI data centre growth outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- Equinix's record third-quarter bookings and stronger-than-expected operating performance have reinforced Mizuho Securities' bullish outlook on the data centre operator, with the brokerage reiterating its top stock pick as demand for AI infrastructure continues to outpace available capacity.

items.title: Bernstein names stocks to buy as data centre political risks appear overstated
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bernstein has recommended buying shares of Quanta Services, Eaton, Vertiv and Equinix, among other companies exposed to artificial intelligence infrastructure, arguing that concerns over political opposition to data centre construction in the United States may have created an attractive buying opportunity ahead of Tuesday's midterm elections.
